short_meaning: Reserved exclusively for designated authorised vehicles such as diplomats.
short_action: Do not enter or park unless driving an authorised vehicle.

short_meaning: Reserved bus stop for picking up and setting down passengers.
short_action: Do not stop or park unless driving an authorised bus.

short_meaning: Reserved stop for minibuses to pick up and set down passengers.
short_action: Do not stop or park unless driving a designated minibus.

short_meaning: Reserved road, lane, or parking area for buses and minibuses.
short_action: Do not enter or park unless driving a bus or minibus.

short_meaning: Dedicated lane reserved exclusively for buses and minibuses.
short_action: Do not drive in this lane unless operating a bus or minibus.

short_meaning: Indicates the start of a reserved bus and minibus lane.
short_action: Do not enter this lane unless driving a bus or minibus.

short_meaning: Reserved road, lane, or parking area for buses and midibuses.
short_action: Do not enter or park unless driving a bus or midibus.

short_meaning: Dedicated lane reserved exclusively for buses and midibuses.
short_action: Do not drive in this lane unless operating a bus or midibus.

short_meaning: Indicates the start of a reserved bus and midibus lane.
short_action: Do not enter this lane unless driving a bus or midibus.

short_meaning: Reserved area for buses, midibuses, and minibuses only.
short_action: Do not enter or park unless driving an allowed public transport vehicle.

short_meaning: Dedicated lane reserved for buses, midibuses, and minibuses.
short_action: Do not use this lane unless driving an allowed transport vehicle.

short_meaning: Indicates the start of a lane for buses, midibuses, and minibuses.
short_action: Do not enter this lane unless driving a bus, midibus, or minibus.

short_meaning: A dual-carriageway freeway begins and freeway rules apply.
short_action: Obey all general freeway rules and speed limits.

short_meaning: A single-carriageway freeway begins and freeway rules apply.
short_action: Obey all freeway rules from this point forward.

short_meaning: Residential area with a 30 km/h speed limit giving pedestrians priority.
short_action: Drive under 30 km/h, watch for children, and yield to pedestrians.

short_meaning: Specifies time periods during which the main regulatory sign applies.
short_action: Comply with the main regulatory sign during the indicated times.

short_meaning: Restricts stopping or parking duration to specified time limits.
short_action: Do not stop or park longer than the indicated time limit.

short_meaning: The main regulatory sign applies when visibility is reduced.
short_action: Obey the main sign whenever weather or light reduces visibility.

short_meaning: The main regulatory sign applies during daytime hours only.
short_action: Obey the main sign during daytime hours.

short_meaning: The main regulatory sign applies during night-time hours only.
short_action: Obey the main sign during night-time hours.

short_meaning: The regulatory restriction applies in the direction of the arrow.
short_action: Obey the main sign in the direction shown by the arrow.

short_meaning: Parking fees must be paid and proof displayed in your vehicle.
short_action: Pay the required fee and clearly display the ticket inside.

short_meaning: The restriction applies only to vehicles of the specified operator.
short_action: Obey the main sign if driving for the indicated organisation.

short_meaning: Restricts the maximum number of vehicles allowed in this area.
short_action: Do not enter if the maximum vehicle limit is reached.

short_meaning: Cancels a previously imposed traffic restriction or prohibition.
short_action: Resume standard driving rules as the previous restriction has ended.

short_meaning: Warns of an upcoming crossroad intersection.
short_action: Slow down, look both ways, and prepare to stop.

short_meaning: Warns of an upcoming crossroad where you have right of way.
short_action: Proceed cautiously and check that cross traffic yields.

short_meaning: Warns of a crossroad where cross traffic has right of way.
short_action: Slow down and yield right of way to cross traffic.

short_meaning: Warns of a T-junction ahead where you must turn sharp left or right.
short_action: Slow down, look for cross traffic, and prepare to turn.

short_meaning: Warns of an upcoming junction where a road joins at an angle.
short_action: Slow down, watch for joining traffic, and prepare to stop.

short_meaning: Warns of a side road joining from the left or right ahead.
short_action: Slow down and look out for entering vehicles.

short_meaning: Warns of two side roads joining your road in close succession.
short_action: Slow down and watch for traffic entering from both sides.

short_meaning: Warns of a sharp merging road or a splitting road layout.
short_action: Watch for merging traffic or choose your lane in advance.

short_meaning: Warns that the road forks into two separate branches ahead.
short_action: Decide early which road to take and watch for crossing traffic.

short_meaning: Warns that a divided dual roadway ends and becomes two-way traffic.
short_action: Keep to the left and prepare for oncoming traffic.

short_meaning: Warns that a two-way road changes into a divided dual roadway ahead.
short_action: Position your vehicle correctly to enter the one-way section.

short_meaning: Warns of a traffic circle ahead where yielding may be required.
short_action: Slow down and yield to traffic inside or approaching from right.

short_meaning: Warns of a gradual curve ahead to the left or right.
short_action: Adjust your speed to navigate the curve safely.

short_meaning: Warns of a sharp curve ahead to the left or right.
short_action: Slow down sufficiently before entering the sharp curve.

short_meaning: Warns of a very sharp hairpin turn ahead.
short_action: Reduce speed significantly to take the sharp turn safely.

short_meaning: Warns of a series of continuous curves ahead.
short_action: Reduce speed and navigate through multiple curves carefully.

short_meaning: Warns of two sharp curves ahead in opposite directions.
short_action: Slow down and prepare for sudden direction changes.

short_meaning: Warns that a one-way street changes to two-way traffic ahead.
short_action: Keep left and watch for oncoming traffic.

short_meaning: Warns that a one-way street is crossed ahead by a two-way street.
short_action: Select the correct turning lane well before the intersection.

short_meaning: Warns that a multi-lane road reduces by one lane ahead.
short_action: Merge safely into the continuing lane in good time.

short_meaning: Warns of hidden driveways entering the road with restricted visibility.
short_action: Slow down and watch for vehicles entering unexpectedly.

short_meaning: Warns of traffic lights ahead at an intersection or crossing.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to stop if the light changes.

short_meaning: Warns of a stop sign ahead that may be hidden from view.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to bring your vehicle to a complete stop.

short_meaning: Warns of a yield sign ahead that may be hidden from view.
short_action: Slow down and be prepared to give way if necessary.

short_meaning: Warns that a traffic officer is controlling traffic ahead.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to stop at the officer's instruction.

short_meaning: Warns that a scholar patrol is active ahead near a school.
short_action: Slow down, watch for children, and obey stop hand-signs.

short_meaning: Warns of a marked pedestrian crossing ahead.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to stop for pedestrians crossing.

short_meaning: Warns that pedestrians may be crossing or walking along the road.
short_action: Slow down and look out for pedestrians along the road.

short_meaning: Warns of children likely to be on or near the road.
short_action: Slow down immediately and watch for children crossing.

short_meaning: Warns that pedal cyclists are likely to be on or crossing the road.
short_action: Slow down and give cyclists plenty of room.

short_meaning: Warns of farm animals that may be straying on or near the road.
short_action: Slow down and watch out for livestock.

short_meaning: Warns of wild animals that may cross the road unexpectedly.
short_action: Slow down and watch for wildlife crossing.

short_meaning: Warns of a railway or roadway barrier gate ahead.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to stop if the gate is closed.

short_meaning: Warns of a motor gate across or next to the roadway ahead.
short_action: Slow down and check for oncoming traffic before passing.

short_meaning: Warns of an upcoming railway level crossing.
short_action: Slow down, check both ways for trains, and stop if required.

short_meaning: Warns of an enclosed road tunnel ahead.
short_action: Slow down and turn on dipped headlights.

short_meaning: Warns of an overhead structure with restricted height clearance.
short_action: Find another route if your vehicle exceeds the height limit.

short_meaning: Warns of road geometry restricting long vehicles ahead.
short_action: Take an alternative route if your vehicle exceeds the length.

short_meaning: Warns of a steep incline or steep decline ahead.
short_action: Select a suitable gear, slow down, and allow extra stopping distance.

short_meaning: Warns of slow-moving heavy trucks on steep downhill grades.
short_action: Slow down and allow extra stopping distance behind trucks.

short_meaning: Warns that the tarred road changes to a gravel surface ahead.
short_action: Slow down to handle the change in road traction safely.

short_meaning: Warns that the roadway narrows over an upcoming bridge.
short_action: Slow down and avoid passing oncoming vehicles on the bridge.

short_meaning: Warns of a narrow bridge allowing only one vehicle at a time.
short_action: Slow down and yield to oncoming traffic already crossing.

short_meaning: Warns that the roadway narrows from both left and right sides.
short_action: Slow down and adjust position away from road edges.

short_meaning: Warns that the road narrows from one side ahead.
short_action: Slow down and move away from the narrowing side.

short_meaning: Warns of bumps, dips, or broken road surfaces ahead.
short_action: Slow down to maintain control and protect your vehicle.

short_meaning: Warns of raised speed humps across the road ahead.
short_action: Reduce speed before driving over the humps.

short_meaning: Warns that the road surface ahead becomes unusually slippery.
short_action: Slow down and avoid sudden braking or sharp turns.

short_meaning: Warns of potential falling rocks or loose debris on the road.
short_action: Slow down and watch for falling rocks or obstacles.

short_meaning: Warns of temporary road construction or maintenance work ahead.
short_action: Slow down and watch for workers or temporary signs.

short_meaning: Warns that a road grader is working on the roadway ahead.
short_action: Slow down and pass the working grader cautiously.

short_meaning: Warns of loose stones or gravel on the road surface.
short_action: Slow down to avoid skidding or throwing up stones.

short_meaning: Warns of unspecified hazard or danger ahead on the road.
short_action: Slow down and stay alert for unexpected hazards.

short_meaning: Warns of an uneven vertical step between lane levels.
short_action: Slow down and avoid sudden steering across the ridge.

short_meaning: Warns that the unpaved road shoulder is soft and uncompacted.
short_action: Avoid driving or pulling over onto the soft shoulder.

short_meaning: Warns of temporary Stop/Go manual traffic control ahead.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to stop if signaled.

short_meaning: Warns that heavy trucks cross or enter the roadway frequently.
short_action: Slow down and watch for slow trucks joining traffic.

short_meaning: Warns of a hazardous traffic condition highlighted by a flashing light.
short_action: Slow down and look out for warning signs indicating the danger.

short_meaning: Warns of a police checkpoint, roadblock, or accident scene ahead.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to stop as directed by officers.

short_meaning: Warns that the road terminates at an unbarricaded water edge.
short_action: Slow down immediately to ensure stopping before the water.

short_meaning: Warns of strong crosswinds that could push vehicles sideways.
short_action: Grip the steering wheel firmly and adjust speed.

short_meaning: Warns of a low water crossing or drift that may flood.
short_action: Slow down, evaluate water depth, and proceed cautiously if safe.

short_meaning: Warns of low-flying aircraft near a runway causing sudden noise.
short_action: Maintain control without braking abruptly out of surprise.

short_meaning: Warns of slow tractors or agricultural machinery on the road.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to yield to farm vehicles.

short_meaning: Warns of a vehicle collision scene obstructing the road ahead.
short_action: Slow down, follow emergency direction, and do not gawk.

short_meaning: Warns of reduced visibility due to heavy fog or smoke.
short_action: Slow down, turn on fog lights, and watch for slow traffic.

short_meaning: Warns of heavy traffic congestion and queued vehicles ahead.
short_action: Slow down early and prepare to join slow traffic.

short_meaning: Warns of horse riders on or alongside the roadway ahead.
short_action: Slow down and leave plenty of room when passing horses.

short_meaning: Warns that elephants may be present on or near the road.
short_action: Slow down, maintain a safe distance, and prepare to stop.

short_meaning: Warns that warthogs may cross or run along the road.
short_action: Slow down and watch for warthogs near road edges.

short_meaning: Warns that hippos may cross the road near water bodies.
short_action: Slow down, stay alert at night, and prepare to stop.

short_meaning: Warns of a narrow roadway section restricting maximum vehicle width.
short_action: Do not proceed if your vehicle width exceeds the limit.

short_meaning: Warns of high-voltage overhead electrical power lines across the road.
short_action: Watch height clearance for tall loads to avoid electric shock.

short_meaning: Warns that a gravel road changes to a paved surface ahead.
short_action: Look out for the paved surface transition ahead.

short_meaning: Marks roadside obstructions and guides vehicle alignment around hazards.
short_action: Pass on the side indicated by the downward slanting stripes.
